title: SEAL: trade the closed hours
story: Earnings drop after the bell... but the stock can't trade until morning. Its Bitget rToken can, all night. SEAL compares that night price with the last official close, and when the gap clears one and a half percent, it trades: with the move on news nights, against it on quiet ones. But one big order in a thin night book gives you away, so SEAL cuts it into eight small clips, sent at random delays. A Python backtest replays real Bitget candles for five stocks, and a dashboard turns the same signal into a pre-open forecast. Every stock wins in sample... out of sample, only Nvidia stays positive. No model picks the trade; one small function does, so anyone can replay the rule... and only the size stays sealed.
